name: Aoba Takumi
source:
Takumi is a high school student who attends Azamino Gakuen, an all boys' school. He belongs to the school's Kyudo (Japanese Archery) club. Takumi resembles a girls because he has a mild-mannered and gentle personality, his stature is small and his hair is soft and silky.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=16327]Getchu[/url].]
